summary: Rows 136-138 are the tail of the manga-adapting run: ep 136 = Level.206 'Arth's Intentions' in full plus the opening pages of Level.207 (Arth leads the group into the return-device room and starts explaining the 28 Demon-World characters), ep 137 = the rest of 207 + 208 'The Light of Hope' (the seal is broken), ep 138 = 209-211, ending exactly on ch 211's last page — Riou announcing that Faudo's target is Japan, 'about an hour from here'. That is the HONEST TERMINAL (G56): ep 138 -> ch 211, vol 22, and the post-series continue is ch 212 (C5, coverage 211 + 1). Ep 138 does NOT straddle into 212, so C1 does not apply. MU's pin ('Vol 22, Chap 212 (Original Ending EP 139-150)') is one chapter AHEAD of the terminal, not redundant and not an edition artifact (G37): it counts the first anime-original episode. Ep 139 'Aim for the Brain! Desperate Re-entry' does restage real, first-time pages of ch 212 — its whole first act (the race after the swimming Faudo, Canchome's distraction, the entry through Faudo's mouth, the gulped seawater, the anatomical-map room, Zaruchim's 'I'm forgetting something') is ch 212 pp. 1-11 read against the MangaDex scan and the Toei official synopsis; from ch 212 p12 (Riou making Faudo cough the group back out) the anime never returns to the manga. Because ~10 of ch 212's 17 story pages carry ep 139's first half, this is a genuine T28 fork rather than a fragment, so a type_correction to mixed is PROPOSED with its counter-evidence stated, and the anchor is WITHHELD in anchor_hostile pending Sean (the zatch-51 precedent). Ep 140 takes neither an anchor nor an anchor_hostile entry: both konjikinogash episode pages give it 'N/A (Filler)', ja-WP bolds it as anime-original and AFL types it Filler — zero source content, filler under A1. Either way the reader-facing answer is stable: resume at ch 212, and ch 212's second half plus 213-323 (the manga's real Faudo conclusion, Clear Note, the ending) are never animated.

THE HONEST TERMINAL (G56): the last row every source calls manga canon. Ends on ch 211's final page - Riou declaring 'Faudo's target will be Japan!!!' and 'about an hour to get there' (the anime says six hours). Ch 212 is NOT entered here, so no C1 straddle. A4.

continue_points.note: Resume at Level.212 'The Worst-case Scenario' (vol 22). C5: coverage 211 + 1. The anime never adapts it as canon - the anime-original ending (eps 139-150) restages only ch 212's first eleven pages before leaving the manga for good, so ch 212's second half (Riou coughing the group out of Faudo, his face-to-face with Kiyomaro) and everything from 213 to the final chapter 323 are unanimated: the manga's real Faudo conclusion, Zeon/Dufort, Clear Note and the ending are all ahead of you.
Ep 136 stops two pages into ch 207 and ep 137 finishes it - resume IN 207 (C1); the same value the plain 206 + 1 reading gives, so the instruction is safe whichever way the END repair is ruled.

anchor_hostile.why: Filler as stored (AFL Filler; ja-WP bolds it as アニメオリジナルストーリー; zatchbell.fandom 'Episodes 139-150 are anime only content'; MU '(Original Ending EP 139-150)'; Sean's batch-17 ruling) - A1 forbids an anchor on a filler row, so none is issued. But the row is NOT contentless: konjikinogash.fandom's per-episode field reads 'Chapter 212 (Partially)' and its own Manga & Anime Differences note says the divergence starts only AFTER the re-entry, and reading ch 212 (MangaDex) against the Toei official synopsis shows the episode's entire first act = ch 212 pp. 1-11, first-time pages, in running order. A type_correction to mixed is proposed below; IF Sean accepts it the anchor would be END 212 / START 212 / chapters_adapted '212 (pp. 1-11 of 17 - through the anatomical-map room; the rest of 212 is never animated)' / vol 22. Withheld pending his ruling, per the zatch-51 precedent.

T28 mandatory tie: ep 139's first act restages ch 212 pp. 1-11 for the first time - the group racing after the swimming Faudo, the entry through his mouth, the seawater he gulps, the anatomical-map room, and Zaruchim's 'I'm forgetting something' - before leaving the manga permanently at ch 212 p12, where Riou makes Faudo cough the group back out (never animated). The anime also stretches Riou's 'one hour to Japan' (ch 211) into six hours to make room for the original ending.
